offers.name: AI Readiness & Workflow Audit
offers.buyer: SMEs with repetitive office, support, sales or reporting work
offers.problem: The company hears about AI but does not know which workflow is safe and financially worthwhile to automate.
offers.deliverables: Process map; prioritized use-case backlog; data/security constraints; ROI assumptions; 30-day pilot recommendation.
offers.scope: Up to 3 workflows, one discovery workshop, written findings. No implementation included.

offers.name: AI Workflow Pilot
offers.buyer: Small professional-services, logistics, property or agricultural businesses
offers.problem: Manual document, email, reporting or knowledge workflows consume staff time.
offers.deliverables: One bounded workflow prototype; human approval step; test cases; error log; before/after time estimate; handover guide.
offers.scope: One workflow, one data source, one pilot team. No autonomous external actions.

offers.name: Private / Local AI Deployment
offers.buyer: SMEs, engineering teams and organisations with sensitive internal information
offers.problem: Need private or controllable AI-assisted workflows without exposing all internal material to public tools.
offers.deliverables: Deployment architecture; model/runtime configuration; access boundaries; basic knowledge ingestion; admin runbook; acceptance tests.
offers.scope: One environment and one use case. Hardware and model/API consumption billed separately.

offers.name: Engineering Knowledge Assistant (RAG)
offers.buyer: Engineering firms, maintenance teams, technical distributors
offers.problem: Technicians cannot quickly find answers across PDFs, manuals, tickets and internal procedures.
offers.deliverables: Ingestion pipeline; source-linked retrieval; access model; evaluation set; feedback capture; source update procedure.
offers.scope: One knowledge domain and up to an agreed document volume. No promise of factual correctness without source validation.

offers.name: Internal AI Assistant Integration
offers.buyer: SMEs already using email, CRM, helpdesk or business software
offers.problem: AI sits outside existing work tools and requires copy/paste or duplicate entry.
offers.deliverables: One or two controlled integrations; role-based access review; data mapping; error handling; audit trail; rollback notes.
offers.scope: Up to two APIs/connectors; customer owns provider subscriptions.

offers.name: AI Agent Safety & Governance Review
offers.buyer: Companies experimenting with agents, browser automation or tool-enabled AI
offers.problem: Unclear what agents can read, change, send, execute or expose.
offers.deliverables: Capability inventory; threat model; prompt-injection review; permission matrix; approval gates; stop/recovery design; test scenarios.
offers.scope: Review of one bounded agent/application. Not a certification or legal opinion.

offers.name: Document Intelligence Pipeline
offers.buyer: Firms processing forms, specifications, maintenance reports or supplier documents
offers.problem: People manually copy data from unstructured documents into business systems.
offers.deliverables: Document intake; extraction schema; confidence thresholds; human review queue; exception report; export/API handoff.
offers.scope: One document family and agreed fields. Accuracy measured on customer-provided sample set.

offers.name: Multi-Model Router / Task Orchestration
offers.buyer: AI product teams and organisations using several models or local/cloud inference
offers.problem: Model use is ad hoc; cost, latency, privacy and task quality are not controlled.
offers.deliverables: Task taxonomy; model registry; routing policy; fallback rules; evaluation harness; cost and latency telemetry.
offers.scope: One application with selected model providers/runtimes. Does not assume a universal best model.

offers.name: Linux / Edge Health Audit
offers.buyer: Small businesses with Linux servers, NAS, gateways or on-prem applications
offers.problem: No reliable inventory of services, access, storage, backups or operational risks.
offers.deliverables: Read-only inventory; service map; exposure review; storage/backup observations; prioritized remediation plan.
offers.scope: One host or small node. No changes performed during the audit.

offers.name: Self-Hosted Edge Deployment
offers.buyer: SMEs needing a local gateway, app, database or internal service
offers.problem: Need a reliable on-prem edge service with explicit backup and maintenance procedures.
offers.deliverables: Deployment; service configuration; least-privilege setup; health checks; backup procedure; rollback/runbook.
offers.scope: One host and one service stack; hardware and external subscriptions excluded.

offers.name: Monitoring & Incident Baseline
offers.buyer: SMEs with servers, edge devices or small OT/IoT fleets
offers.problem: Failures are discovered by users rather than monitoring; no service baseline exists.
offers.deliverables: Service/device inventory; health checks; alert routing; dashboard; runbook; monthly status report.
offers.scope: Up to 5 monitored nodes/services as initial scope.
offers.recurring: €120–450/month based on scope and alert coverage

offers.name: Backup & Recovery Design
offers.buyer: SMEs holding business-critical data but lacking tested recovery
offers.problem: Backups exist but restore time, completeness and integrity are unknown.
offers.deliverables: Data inventory; RPO/RTO proposal; backup design; retention plan; one restore test; recovery checklist.
offers.scope: One or two systems; storage costs excluded.

offers.name: IT/OT Network Segmentation Plan
offers.buyer: Manufacturing, building automation, labs and smart facilities
offers.problem: Office IT, remote access and control networks have unclear trust boundaries.
offers.deliverables: Asset/flow map; trust-boundary diagram; access matrix; segmentation target; staged migration plan.
offers.scope: Design and bounded assessment only; production changes require separate approval and change window.

offers.name: IoT / OT Integration Prototype
offers.buyer: Equipment integrators, farms, small manufacturers and R&D teams
offers.problem: Sensors, controllers and business software cannot exchange validated data cleanly.
offers.deliverables: Interface specification; edge collector; normalized telemetry; error states; test protocol; integration demo.
offers.scope: One protocol/interface and a bench or test setup; no live safety-critical control.

offers.name: Secure Remote Access for Distributed Nodes
offers.buyer: Small distributed teams, field operators, farms and labs
offers.problem: Remote support depends on exposed ports, ad hoc VPNs or fragile access arrangements.
offers.deliverables: Private connectivity design; identity/access model; node enrolment; admin runbook; revocation test.
offers.scope: Up to 5 nodes in initial scope; third-party subscriptions may apply.

offers.name: Authorized Security Posture Review
offers.buyer: SMEs and technology teams with explicit scope and permission
offers.problem: Unclear exposure, account hygiene, update posture and operational security controls.
offers.deliverables: Scope record; passive review; configuration evidence; risk register; prioritized remediation plan.
offers.scope: Only explicitly authorized assets; no intrusive testing unless separately scoped.

offers.name: Cybersecurity Readiness Evidence Pack
offers.buyer: Suppliers and organisations checking applicability of cybersecurity obligations
offers.problem: Technical evidence is scattered; management cannot see gaps in inventory, access, backups or incident handling.
offers.deliverables: Applicability questions for counsel/compliance owner; asset register; technical evidence index; gap log; remediation roadmap.
offers.scope: Technical preparation only; no legal opinion, certification or conformity assessment. Applicability must be confirmed by competent adviser.

offers.name: DevSecOps Pipeline Baseline
offers.buyer: Software SMEs and internal product teams
offers.problem: Build/release process lacks repeatable security checks, artifact provenance or rollback discipline.
offers.deliverables: CI checks; secret scanning; dependency checks; artifact handling; deployment gates; rollback notes.
offers.scope: One repository and one CI platform to start. No guarantee of absence of vulnerabilities.

offers.name: Software Supply Chain & Secrets Review
offers.buyer: Software vendors, integrators and teams preparing procurement/security reviews
offers.problem: Dependency risk, leaked credentials and software components are poorly documented.
offers.deliverables: Dependency/SBOM snapshot; secret exposure review; critical findings list; remediation tickets; re-scan plan.
offers.scope: One or two repositories; only owned/authorized projects.

offers.name: Technical Architecture & Operations Documentation
offers.buyer: SMEs, integrators, R&D teams and subcontractors
offers.problem: System knowledge is trapped in people's heads, old diagrams or inconsistent documents.
offers.deliverables: System context; interface/data-flow diagrams; deployment and operational runbook; assumptions; risks; change record.
offers.scope: One system boundary and agreed source material.

offers.name: CEA System Architecture Blueprint
offers.buyer: Indoor growers, greenhouse operators, investors and equipment integrators
offers.problem: Growing environment, sensors, pumps, controls, data and maintenance are specified as disconnected parts.
offers.deliverables: System context; subsystem architecture; equipment/interface list; control/safety boundaries; staged CAPEX/OPEX assumptions.
offers.scope: Concept/design stage only; agronomic results and regulatory acceptance not guaranteed.

offers.name: Sensor & Measurement Validation
offers.buyer: CEA operators, labs and small process-control teams
offers.problem: Sensor readings drift or disagree; control decisions use untrusted data.
offers.deliverables: Sensor inventory; measurement chain review; calibration/verification plan; uncertainty log; acceptance limits.
offers.scope: Up to an agreed sensor set; calibration equipment and accredited calibration excluded.

offers.name: Grow-Room Telemetry Retrofit
offers.buyer: Indoor farms, research growers and pilot greenhouses
offers.problem: Environmental readings are local, inconsistent or not recorded centrally.
offers.deliverables: Sensor/edge design; data collection; dashboard; alert boundaries; installation documentation; test protocol.
offers.scope: One zone; installation materials, electrical work and specialist certification excluded unless separately contracted.

offers.name: Hydroponics Monitoring Dashboard
offers.buyer: Hydroponic growers and CEA R&D teams
offers.problem: pH, EC/TDS, temperature, tank level and pump status are recorded manually or not historically.
offers.deliverables: Telemetry model; data store; dashboard; quality flags; alarm rules; operator instructions.
offers.scope: Monitoring/decision support only; automatic dosing or pump control requires separate deterministic safety design.

offers.name: Environmental Monitoring Subscription
offers.buyer: Small indoor farms, propagation rooms and research facilities
offers.problem: Operators need ongoing trend visibility and alerts without maintaining the monitoring stack.
offers.deliverables: Dashboard access; agreed alerting; monthly uptime/data quality report; support window.
offers.scope: Pricing depends on sites/nodes, data retention and response expectations; not 24/7 unless contracted.

offers.name: Irrigation / Fertigation Decision Support
offers.buyer: CEA growers and agricultural R&D teams
offers.problem: Irrigation decisions rely on fragmented sensor logs and operator memory.
offers.deliverables: Data model; thresholds/trend view; recommendation logic; operator confirmation; trial protocol.
offers.scope: Advisory only. No AI direct actuation or unvalidated dosing recipes.

offers.name: Phenotyping / Visual Inspection PoC
offers.buyer: Seed, plant-science, vertical farming and research teams
offers.problem: Manual visual scoring is slow and inconsistent across batches or trials.
offers.deliverables: Image capture protocol; annotation schema; baseline computer-vision model; evaluation report; data governance notes.
offers.scope: One crop/trait and controlled sample set; biological inference remains experimental.

offers.name: Farm Energy & Water Intelligence
offers.buyer: Greenhouses, indoor farms and small food producers
offers.problem: Energy and water consumption are not correlated with production zones or operating cycles.
offers.deliverables: Meter/data inventory; collection design; KPI dashboard; anomaly flags; monthly baseline report.
offers.scope: Monitoring and analysis; savings are not guaranteed and require measured baseline.

offers.name: Technical Feasibility Sprint
offers.buyer: Founders, SMEs and R&D teams with a vague technical concept
offers.problem: The team needs to know whether a concept can be built, what it costs and what can fail.
offers.deliverables: Requirements; architecture options; risk register; rough BOM/dependency plan; prototype acceptance criteria.
offers.scope: One concept and agreed decision questions; no prototype unless separately scoped.

offers.name: Prototype Integration Sprint
offers.buyer: Hardware startups, integrators, university spinouts and R&D teams
offers.problem: A promising prototype consists of parts that have not been made into a repeatable system.
offers.deliverables: Interface contracts; integrated prototype; test harness; issue log; build/run instructions; demo.
offers.scope: One bounded integration milestone; component procurement and certification excluded.

offers.name: Verification & Validation Pack
offers.buyer: Product teams, subcontractors, R&D projects and equipment integrators
offers.problem: There is no traceable link between requirements, test cases, results and unresolved limitations.
offers.deliverables: Requirements traceability matrix; test protocol; test evidence index; deviations; verification report.
offers.scope: Technical documentation and tests within agreed access; not a conformity assessment or certification.

offers.name: Fractional Systems Architect
offers.buyer: Small technology firms without a full-time systems architect
offers.problem: Architecture decisions, interfaces and technical debt have no consistent owner.
offers.deliverables: Monthly architecture hours; design reviews; decision records; risk tracking; stakeholder technical sessions.
offers.scope: Prepaid monthly capacity with explicit hours and response window; no unlimited availability.

offers.name: Remote R&D Engineering Partner
offers.buyer: Hardware, AgTech and deep-tech teams that need cross-discipline integration
offers.problem: Research, electronics, embedded, edge, software and verification are fragmented among suppliers.
offers.deliverables: Work-package ownership; interface coordination; integration plan; weekly progress/evidence report; issue and risk register.
offers.scope: Capacity-limited engagement; physical installation, on-site travel and third-party procurement separately priced.
